instruction: Find the longest movie title in the "Garbage Movie titles" column (based on character count including spaces) and apply any background color highlighting to that cell.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the longest title by character count (including spaces) in column B and highlighting it. Evaluator finds the cell with the longest title in column B dynamically, then verifies that cell is highlighted. Awards full credit (1.0) if correct cell is highlighted, partial credit (0.5) if wrong cell is highlighted, 0.0 if no highlighting.

Dynamic verification logic: The getter get_xlsx_longest_title_cell__4cbe5073 dynamically finds the cell with the longest title at runtime by iterating through all cells in column B and comparing character counts (xlsx_longest_title.py:63-76). There is NO hardcoding of cell references.

Correct getter 1 logic: get_xlsx_longest_title_cell__4cbe5073 correctly calculates character count including spaces using len(str(cell_value)) and returns the cell reference, length, and content of the longest title.
Correct getter 2 logic: get_xlsx_highlighted_cells__4cbe5073 correctly identifies highlighted cells by checking fill.patternType and filtering out 'none' patterns (xlsx_highlighted_cells.py:58-62).
